## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.9`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noAstroComponentDefaultExport`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**error**](/reference/diagnostics#error).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`astro`](/linter/domains#astro)
- Sources: 
  - Inspired from [`astro/no-exports-from-components`](https://ota-meshi.github.io/eslint-plugin-astro/rules/no-exports-from-components)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noAstroComponentDefaultExport": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow runtime default exports in Astro component frontmatter.

Astro generates the runtime default export for each component. Defining another
runtime default export in the component frontmatter conflicts with that generated export.
Named exports and type-only default exports are allowed.

## Examples

### Invalid

```astro
---
export default function render() {}
---
```

